ShipmentEventActor.description:
USER indicates a verified authenticated user from persisted status history.
SYSTEM indicates an explicit server-side transition; never inferred from missing user context on HTTP mutations.

id.description: Present for USER canonical history events.

name.description: Not populated from status history in v0.1.

ShipmentEventSource.description:
BFF-generated timeline events from current entity state use *_STATE or SLA_CALCULATOR sources and are always derived=true.
Persisted shipment status transitions use SHIPMENT_STATUS_HISTORY with derived=false and sourceEventId set to the history row ID.

shipmentEventsLoaded.description: True when persisted shipment status history was loaded; false only when the internal history source is unavailable. Empty history for a legacy shipment still sets this to true.
